test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer - General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Town T is to the south of town U. Town V is to the east of town T. Town X is to the north of town V. Town Y is to the north of town X. Town Z is to the west of town Y. What can be the position of town Z with respect to town T?
solution:
Given: 

Town T is to the south of town U.

Town V is to the east of town T.

Town X is to the north of town V.

Town Y is to the north of town X.

Town Z is to the west of town Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d33a0641976b388dc96dba9cab5bed3b8026f564e6f547c0f4cd1738f6e31ed.png] 

Thus, town Z is to the north of town T.

Hence, **"Option 2" **is the correct answer.
